positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description: Developed a modular, web-based software for Commercial Bank Loan Origination Systems using Node.js and React. Utilized an Oracle database to store customer data and Apache Tomcat webservers. Collected information from non-technical users and created web applications that serve their workflow needs.

positions.title: Masters Student
positions.description: Implemented a computational neural network to provide error corrections for nearshore wave forecasts for the US west coast using MatLab, Python, NumPy, TensorFlow, and PyTorch. Collected, compiled, and analyzed observational data from NDBC, CPID, and Sofar wave buoys and forecast data from NOAA’s Wave Watch III computational wave model. Conducting statistical analysis of improvements to the forecast using machine learning model.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Developing a neural network using PyTorch to output hydrodynamic and water quality model correction values to apply to Pacific Northwest National Laboratory’s Salish Sea Model in collaboration with machine learning research group.

positions.title: Computer Science Mentor and Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Tutor computer science students with homework and assignments and provide guidance on computer science related questions. Prepared and presented lab assignments, and graded student work.

positions.title: Computer Science Intern
positions.description: Developed a graphical user interface for a Fortran code modeling wastewater outfall plume dilution and transport in Salish Sea. Coded in Python using the Tk GUI toolkit to create a cross platform interface. Facilitates use of the model by a broad audience including the regulatory and wastewater engineering communities.

positions.title: Coastal Science Intern
positions.description: Curated underwater video of seafloor conditions for the Elwha River Restoration Project. Developed content for interactive website documenting biological and habitat changes at the estuary after dam removal.

volunteerExperiences.description: Participated in a study of marine plastics. Performed field and lab work. Dissected seagull boli, collected and sorted beach plastics. Articulated orca whale and seal pup skeletons for museum display about toxins in the ocean. Marine Mammal Stranding Network responder. Docent for marine exhibits and touch tanks.
Identified and counted out-migrating salmon smolts in the spring and spawning adult salmon in the fall. Sampled scales and otoliths, and assisted with beach seining and beach profile surveys.
